title: A Orchard for the Compass
author: Jude Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Nakamura, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
